en: A black-and-white photograph showing a calm river with a paddle steamer or riverboat docked at a small pier. The opposite bank is lined with a scattering of houses and farm buildings, with terraced vineyards or cultivated fields climbing a hillside. The landscape is distinctly European, rural, and hilly, with a small settlement visible. There are no prominent or famous architectural landmarks; the main focus is the natural scenery and traditional rural buildings.
